description: A Java class implementing a stream processor using Akka streams to limit the rate of elements passing through based on a time interval and rejection policy, forwarding accepted elements and rejecting excess with error messages.

classes.name: LimitRateByRejection
classes.description: A utility class providing static factory methods and internal logic to create a rate-limiting stream Graph based on rejection policy.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a graph limiting the number of elements passing through within a specified time window, rejecting excess elements and generating errors via a provided reporter function.
